name: theocode
description: theocode: grok-driven agent workspace (projects → sessions → subagents) with MCP onboarding

scripts.build:main: bun build src/main.ts src/preload.ts --outdir dist --target node --format cjs --external electron --external sql.js
scripts.build:renderer: bun build src/renderer/renderer.ts --outdir dist/renderer --target browser && cp src/renderer/index.html src/renderer/app.css dist/renderer/ && cp -R src/renderer/assets dist/renderer/
scripts.build: bun run build:main && bun run build:renderer
scripts.start: bun run build && node scripts/dev.mjs -- electron .
